get.summary: Lists the active login providers.
Starts a login with the provider and redirects back to returnUrl (an app-relative path) afterwards.

post.summary: Ends the session (and the IdP session for OIDC logins) and redirects to the login page.

get.summary: 200 while the instance owner is unclaimed and the first-run setup is available, otherwise 404.

post.summary: Claims the instance owner: sets user name, display name and password, grants admin and signs in.
Signs in with user name and password.
WebAuthn request options (PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions JSON) for passkey login.
Signs in with a passkey assertion (PublicKeyCredential JSON).
WebAuthn creation options (PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions JSON) to add a passkey to the signed-in user.
Stores a passkey attestation for the signed-in user.

get.summary: The current user: id, display name, roles and scopes.
A token for the X-XSRF-TOKEN header of state-changing requests. Fetch a new one after login or logout.
Server-sent live updates for the comma-separated topics (event name = event type, data = LiveEventMessage).
The user's runs (voice, web, task, api), newest first; filter by source, outcome and minimum cost, page with before.
One run: context build, model calls, tool calls with guard decisions, taint sources and the reply.
Cost per day and tier in the user's time zone, advisor separately (default: the last 30 days).
The app version and the supported and deprecated API versions.
Loaded skills, templates, MCP servers, risk rules, models and satellites, plus the last load error per file.

post.summary: Runs one conversation turn and streams the reply as server-sent events (delta, status, final).

get.summary: The user's API tokens without secrets; executor callback tokens are read-only.

post.summary: Creates a token with scopes the user holds; the plaintext is returned only in this response.

delete.summary: Revokes one of the user's tokens.

get.summary: Every secret visible to the user (own, instance, environment) without values, plus unresolved references.

put.summary: Creates or replaces one of the user's secrets.

delete.summary: Deletes one of the user's secrets.

get.summary: Instance secrets (database and environment) without values.

put.summary: Creates or replaces an instance secret.

get.summary: Language, time zone, quiet hours, notification targets and do-not-disturb of the user.
Chunks newest first, or ranked by relevance with query; filter by type, scope, projectId and pinned.

post.summary: Writes a chunk through its deterministic id (an existing chunk with the same identity is updated).

get.summary: A chunk (also when deleted) with its earlier versions and its edges.

put.summary: Changes content, importance and source; the previous content becomes a version.

delete.summary: Soft-deletes a chunk; it is no longer retrieved.

put.summary: Pins a chunk: it is injected in full in every turn.

post.summary: Writes a replacement with a new identity and a supersedes edge to the chunk.

get.summary: Predecessors, earlier versions and the current content, oldest first.
Stale chunks, open contradictions, orphans and dangling edges.
Chunks, versions, edges and projects as NDJSON (without embeddings).
Live projects with aliases, alias candidates and chunk counts.

post.summary: Creates a project; names are unique.

delete.summary: Deletes a project; its chunks stay and show up as orphans in the audit.

post.summary: Adds an active alias (or activates an existing candidate).

put.summary: Promotes or rejects an alias or alias candidate.

delete.summary: Removes an alias or alias candidate.

get.summary: The project's correction log, newest first.

readOnly.description: True for tokens users cannot manage (executor callback tokens).

ApiTokenResponse.description: A machine token without its secret.

ChunkEditRequest.description: New content of a chunk; identity fields cannot change (supersede instead).

title.description: Short English title (part of the identity).

ChunkWriteRequest.description: A chunk to write (create or supersede replacement).

message.description: What is wrong (never contains secret values).

previousVersionActive.description: True when the previous version of the file stays active; false when the entry is skipped.

ConfigError.description: A config file whose last load failed.

templates.description: Loaded agent templates, including the built-in default unless replaced.

mcpServers.description: Configured MCP servers with their connection status.

riskRules.description: Active risk rules in evaluation order (first match wins).

models.description: Configured models; API keys by secret name only.

conversationId.description:
Token clients: their own conversation id (required). Browser sessions: Marshal's session id
from an earlier final event; omitted starts a new conversation.

text.description: What the user said or typed.

language.description: Request language (`de` or `en`); the reply uses it.

haUserId.description: Home Assistant user id, if known.

inputMode.description: `voice` when the turn went through speech-to-text, otherwise `text`.

followupRef.description: Opaque reference from a voice follow-up; unknown values are ignored.

name.description: Label, e.g. the client using it.

scopes.description: Scopes to grant; each must be one the user holds.

token.description: The plaintext; shown only in this response.

type.description: Event type, e.g. `run.completed` (also the SSE event name).

LocalSetupRequest.description: First-run setup: the instance owner's login.

LocalSetupStatus.description: Whether the first-run setup is available.

LoginProviderInfo.description: A login provider as shown on the login page.

untrusted.description: Its tool output taints the run.

authTokenSecret.description: Secret name of the bearer token, if any.

environmentSecrets.description: Secret names passed as environment variables (stdio).

edges.description: Edges from and to the chunk.

MemoryChunkDetail.description: A chunk with its history data.

displayName.description: Name used in the UI and the system prompt.

scopes.description: Scopes: granted by the roles for cookie sessions, the token's own for tokens.

apiKeySecret.description: Secret name of the API key, if any.

PasskeyOptionsRequest.description: Passkey login options; without a user name the options allow any discoverable passkey.

PasskeyRegistrationRequest.description: A new passkey for the signed-in user.

ProjectRequest.description: Name and description of a project.

denyTools.description: Tool globs hidden on this satellite.

denyConfirm.description: Tool globs whose confirm-tier calls are refused on this satellite.

updatedAt.description: Last change of a database secret.

readOnly.description: True when the current user cannot change it here.

SecretOverview.description: The secrets view: every visible secret and every reference that does not resolve.

SecretValueRequest.description: A secret value to store. It is never returned.

files.description: Additional files, relative to the skill.

version.description: App version (informational version, including the commit when built from source).

supportedApiVersions.description: API versions this build serves, e.g. `1.0`.

deprecatedApiVersions.description: Supported versions that will be removed.

modelTier.description: Fixed model tier; null = by input mode.

tools.description: Tool id globs it may use.

skills.description: Skills it may use; null = all.

UnresolvedSecret.description: A referenced secret that no source provides.

language.description: `de` or `en`; used when a request has no language.

quietHours.description: Weekly quiet-hour windows; an end before the start ends the next day.

UserPreferencesResponse.description: A user's preferences. Content preferences (briefing topics, interests) live in memory, not here.
